regime_context: The detector shows a broad (9/16 eligible), rotating precious-metals-led tape with Silver & Royalties narrowly ahead of Gold Miners, but its own verdict is discipline_not_prediction — rank-IC ~0 and rotation timing display-only. The only validated edge is drawdown control via the absolute-trend gate, which is helping on this market (gate_helps true), so the note stays humble: attention lens, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching Insurers (rank 6) — it is the only crowded theme (crowding_z 1.05) and unscorable with no ETF proxy, so no lean can be graded there; I am watching whether it crosses into confirmed leadership (rising rank toward the top two eligible and a durability bar above 0.60) while staying under the crowding cap — the condition that would retire this watch is Insurers posting a durable top-3 eligible rank for two consecutive weekly detector readings.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties ranks #1, is eligible under the validated absolute-trend gate, shows full breadth (1.0) and a durability bar of 0.62 — the staying-power leg is intact and un-crowded (crowding_z 0.69, not crowded). This is not a return forecast; it is a conditional lean that the trend discipline (the one leg with history) keeps this theme as a focus candidate while the gate holds.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert (r10 -0.0345) and the theme is only narrowly ahead of Gold Miners (margin 0.142) — it may be near a local top rather than a durable trend, and the backtest says rank-IC ~0 so leadership can decay fast.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO gives back its relative edge to the S&P/TSX and the theme drops out of the top-2 eligible ranks by the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the rotation challenger (score 1.745) and shares the XGD.TO proxy, so it is part of the same precious-metals focus cluster. The lean is essentially the same conditional: while it remains eligible under the trend gate and the broader precious-metals group holds breadth/durability, it warrants a positive directional lean as a co-leader.
theses.dissent: Same proxy as Silver & Royalties means no diversification between the two calls; if precious metals mean-revert (Silver's Hurst already flagging mean-revert), both names fall together and the defensive gate may not save the relative call.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO breaks below its own absolute-trend gate and the precious-metals cluster loses its eligible status in the top-2 by the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals ranks #4 and is eligible, but its Hurst tag is mean-revert, durability is middling (0.54), and the detector's verified edge is drawdown avoidance via the trend gate — which argues for de-emphasizing mean-revert materials with only moderate breadth (0.667) relative to the precious-metals leader. This is a sizing-down directional lean, not a short.
theses.dissent: Copper/base metals often benefit from the same industrial-cyclical and China-stimulus flows that can lift energy and industrials; the theme could rotate up quickly if macro expectations improve, leaving this lean premature.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO prints a higher eligible rank and durability than the precious-metals cluster by the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
